verdict.rationale: Sketch documents an official, supported JavaScript API for building plugins, plus the skpm plugin manager, the sketchtool CLI and a public document-format repo. That counts as genuine first-party developer tooling. However, it is an in-app plugin API rather than general-purpose language SDKs, and no OpenAPI or REST SDK surface was found (all probes 404). missing for 10: official multi-language or server-side SDKs for a web/REST API, documented API specification, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use in AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: An official vanilla JavaScript API, fully supported between releases.
Write a Sketch plugin in JavaScript. Take advantage of ES6, access macOS frameworks and use the Sketch APIs without learning Objective-C or Swift.
Use the Sketch Plugin Manager `skpm` to publish a new plugin or an update of an existing one.
Integrate Sketch into your workflows and server applications, on any platform.
